name: Getting a Visum
examples: How do I get a visum for Singapore?
How can I apply for a visa?
How to get a travel visa?

responses.expression: A visum (visa) is an official permission to enter a country. To get a visa for Singapore, you should check the official Singapore Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA) website or contact the nearest Singapore embassy. Requirements usually include a valid passport, application form, photographs, and supporting documents. Visa rules depend on your nationality.
